name: discord-pager
description: Pager-style buzzer for important Discord DMs and mentions. Windows listens, Mac buzzes.
author: REDFC

scripts.build:helper: dotnet publish helper-win/NotificationHelper.csproj -c Release -r win-x64 --self-contained true -p:PublishSingleFile=true -o resources/helper
scripts.dist:win: node scripts/check-signing.js && npm run build:helper && npm run build && electron-builder --win
